event_text: American troops destroy the Miami town of Kenapacomaqua near the site of present-day Logansport, Indiana in the Northwest Indian War.
headline: Northwest Indian War: American Troops Destroy Kenapacomaqua
story: Barry and Susan perched on a cypress tree overlooking the Wabash River, watching as American troops, led by General Charles Scott, descended upon the Miami town of Kenapacomaqua. "Right, Susan, so the Northwest Indian War is in full swing, and the Americans are trying to assert their control over the region," Barry said, preening his feathers. "The Miamis, under Chief Little Turtle, have been resisting, and now the Americans are taking a rather... drastic approach." Susan cocked her head, "You mean burning the town to the ground and killing anyone who gets in their way?" Barry nodded, "Yes, that's the one. All part of the fun and games of westward expansion. The Americans claim it's a necessary measure to protect their settlers, but really, it's just a classic case of might makes right." Susan ruffled her feathers, "And what about the Miami people? Don't they have a say in all this?" Barry snorted, "Oh, please, they're just 'savages' to the Americans. Unfortunate obstacles to progress, that's all."
regret_line: A bit more foresight and a lot less gunpowder might have been a good idea, in hindsight.
winner_line: The concept of Manifest Destiny, which would go on to justify countless more atrocities against Native American tribes.
